name: Acceptance suite-2 test 48 boundary - a specific (non-wildcard) Principal ARN is valid
note: IAM-903 boundary: a concrete IAM role ARN with NO partial wildcard is a valid Principal element. It must remain an ordinary external/cross-account trust finding and must NOT be flagged invalid. Confirms the invalid-wildcard detection keys on an actual '*'/'?' in the Principal ARN, not on principal ARNs in general.
